title: 第2018章 斩杀银雕天龙灵影第2017章 欲逃
slug: 灵源仙途我养的灵兽太懂感恩了
content_zh:
“狗急跳墙，也不过狂吠几声罢了！”
顾安一戟斩落，破开如陨石般坠下的真仙环，将其中正欲逃遁的银色道果挑到身前，造化灵光涌出，瞬间将其封印，“就这点实力，还想从我的手中逃脱？！”
嗤笑一声，翻掌将其收入袖中。
周天星辰戟甩开银血，锋芒直指赤元真仙，“你也一样！”
赤元真仙的面色阴沉如水，它本以为和银雕真仙联手之下，就算是付出一定的代价，但怎么也能逃走！
毕竟以一敌二，能胜就极强了，若是都斩了，未免也太不可思议。
但古冥真仙这架势，却大有可能。
十年搏杀，银雕伤势越来越重，底牌越来越薄，终于是被那古冥真仙一波爆发，给取了性命。
但它也没好到哪里去！
当年这古冥真仙只盯着银雕打的时候，它对其实力，还没有清楚的感知，如今十年鏖战，才知道为何当年银雕一心要逃。
但代价是，它也深受重伤。
“不能被它看出来。”
赤元真仙心中暗想，吞下最后一颗丹药，赤金色的龙瞳中凶光闪烁，“古冥，你的实力的确超出我的预料，但斩了银雕，想必也受了不轻的伤吧！”
此时它将至绝路，但越是如此，越不能怕，越不能露出自己的虚弱！
只是，人家压根不吃这套！
“就凭你们两个？”听到这话，顾安不禁嗤笑，周天星辰戟一荡，“少废话，受没受伤，来试试不就完了！”
血光与煞气注入周天星辰戟中，使得这杆长戟威势愈重。
而太虚扶摇翼振动，只瞬间便将这杆凶兵送到赤元真仙眼前。
嗡——
锋芒划过长天，破开重重火浪，与那残余的龙爪相交，顿时有金火迸发，荡开一阵阵狂暴的灵波。

但纵使那龙爪被赤元真仙淬炼多年，又如何能与周天星辰戟相比？
戟锋刺入血肉，煞气与血光如天河决堤。
但这并不是最让赤元真仙头疼的，真正让它暗骂不止的，还是那趁机渗入体内的青色灵光——交手多年，它在这灵光上吃过太多的亏！
“吼！！”
一声怒吼响起，赤元真仙体内燃起血火，虽无法将青色灵光烧灭，却能暂时遏制。
受创的赤元真仙愈发凶狂！
身后残破的赤金洞天流转，喷出一股股赤金洪流，凝为一线，嗡鸣着划破长空，向着顾安极速杀去。
被逼到绝路的赤元真仙，燃洞天，燃精血，燃真仙天，打出这威势恐怖的一击。
纵使顾安也不敢小觑！
“敕！”
顾安轻吟一声，太极万劫塔全力催动，黑白灵光大盛，化为重重灵罩护在周身，与此同时打出道道法术阻拦。
轰！！
赤金一线如锥穿纸，破碎重重法术而来，落在黑白灵罩上，亦将其打的震动不止。
但毕竟是七阶极品仙器，并未就此破去。
“轮到我了！”
漫天火雨中，一声暴喝响起。
顾安不退反进，周天星辰戟骤然逆转，戟身上的星纹亮如白昼，闪烁着凛冽锋芒，向着赤元真仙悍然杀去！
content_en:
"A dog jumping over a wall in a hurry can only bark a few times!"
Gu An slashed down with a halberd, breaking the true immortal ring that fell like a meteorite, and picked up the silver Dao Fruit that was about to escape in front of him. The spiritual light of creation surged out and sealed it instantly, "With this strength, you still want to escape from my hands?!"
With a sneer, he turned his palm and put it into his sleeve.
The Zhoutian Star Halberd shook off the silver blood, and pointed its sharp edge at True Immortal Chi Yuan, "The same goes for you!"
The face of True Immortal Chi Yuan was as gloomy as water. It thought that by joining forces with True Immortal Silver Eagle, it would be able to escape even if it paid a certain price!
After all, with one against two, it would be extremely powerful to win. It would be unbelievable to kill them all.
But the posture of Gu Ming Zhenxian is very possible.
After ten years of fighting, Silver Eagle's injuries became more and more serious, and his trump card became weaker and weaker. Finally, he was killed by a wave of attacks from the Ancient Ming True Immortal.
But it’s not much better!
Back then, when the Gu Ming True Immortal only stared at the Silver Eagle, it had no clear perception of its strength. Now, after ten years of fierce fighting, it is now clear why the Silver Eagle wanted to escape.
But the price is that it is also seriously injured.
"Can't be seen by it."
True Immortal Chi Yuan thought to himself, swallowing the last pill, the red-gold dragon eyes flashed with fierce light, "Gu Ming, your strength is indeed beyond my expectation, but you must have suffered serious injuries after killing the silver eagle!"
At this point it will reach a dead end, but the more it is like this, the less afraid it is and the less it can reveal its weakness!
It's just that people don't like this at all!
"Just the two of you?" Hearing this, Gu An couldn't help but sneer, Zhou Tianxingchen halberd swung, "Stop talking nonsense, it won't hurt, just give it a try!"
Blood light and evil energy were injected into the Zhoutian Star Halberd, making the halberd more powerful.
Taixu's swinging wings vibrated, sending the fierce weapon to the eyes of True Immortal Chi Yuan in an instant.
Buzz——
The sharp edge streaked across the sky, breaking through the waves of fire, and when it intersected with the remaining dragon claws, golden fire burst out, creating waves of violent spiritual waves.
But even if the dragon claw has been tempered by True Immortal Chi Yuan for many years, how can it compare with the Zhoutian Star Halberd?
The sharp edge of the halberd pierced into the flesh and blood, and the evil spirit and bloody light were like the Milky Way bursting its banks.
But this is not what troubles True Immortal Chi Yuan the most. What really makes him curse is the cyan aura that takes the opportunity to seep into the body - after many years of fighting, it has suffered too many losses from this aura!
"Roar!!"
A roar rang out, and blood fire ignited in the body of True Immortal Chi Yuan. Although it could not burn out the green spiritual light, it could be temporarily contained.
The injured Chi Yuan Zhenxian became even more ferocious!
The broken red gold cave sky behind him circulated, spurting out torrents of red gold, condensing into a line, buzzing across the sky, and killing Gu An at great speed.
The Chi Yuan True Immortal who was forced to a dead end, Burning Cave Heaven, Burning Essence and Blood, Burning True Immortal Heaven, struck this terrifying blow.
Even Gu An doesn’t dare to underestimate him!
"Edict!"
Gu An groaned softly, and the Tai Chi Tower of Ten Thousand Tribulations was activated with all its strength. The black and white spiritual light flourished, turning into a heavy spiritual shield to protect the whole body, and at the same time, he cast spells to block him.
boom! !
A thread of red gold penetrated paper like a cone, shattering numerous spells and falling on the black and white spirit shield, shaking it.
But after all, it is a seventh-level top-grade immortal weapon, and it has not been broken.
"It's my turn!"
Amidst the fire and rain, a loud shout rang out.
Gu An did not retreat but advanced. The Zhoutian Star Halberd suddenly reversed its direction. The star pattern on the halberd was as bright as daylight, flashing with a sharp edge, and it charged towards the True Immortal Chi Yuan!
